_comment: The Royal Gift: a reward for coming back each day (UTC days, like the daily tasks). One a day, taken by hand. `days` is a week of gifts: day 1 the first day, day 2 the next day in a row and so on; after day 7 the week starts again at day 1. Missing a day starts over at day 1. Every full week in a row adds `week_bonus` to the gifts, up to `max_weeks` weeks. Rewards are multiplied by `scale` for the keep level (keep 1, 2, ...), like the daily tasks, and given in full, even past the storage cap. Troops and chests are not scaled. Nothing here can be bought.
name: Royal Gift
line: The king remembers lords who keep their halls. A gift came at dawn, my lord.
